<thought>The ¹H NMR shows three singlets integrating to 3 H, 6 H, and 3 H respectively. All signals correspond to methyl protons (CH₃). Summing the integrations gives 12 protons, which equals four methyl groups. Therefore the compound contains 4 CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
